latestVersion.changelog: Initial release of SeaArt Image Generator skill. Features: 14 built-in models (SeaArt Infinity, Film series, Seedream series, Nano Banana series, Grok Imagine, Z Image Turbo, WAI-ANI-PONYXL), smart HD/SD resolution auto-scaling, 7 aspect ratios, LoRA support, negative prompts, and custom model support via URL.
